summary: Implement a function from an exact formatting spec with edge cases.
prompt: Implement `format_duration(seconds)` in durations.py. `seconds` is a non-negative int; a negative value raises ValueError. The result uses hours, minutes and seconds (no days) and starts at the largest non-zero unit: 3723 gives "1h 02m 03s", 65 gives "1m 05s", 7 gives "7s", 0 gives "0s", 3600 gives "1h 00m 00s" and 90000 gives "25h 00m 00s". The first unit is not zero-padded; every later unit has two digits.
